segments.an5.77:1.1: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena [āraññakena (sabbattha a. ni. 5.181; pari. 443)] bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.77:2.4: Ekakaṃ kho pana maṃ [ekakaṃ kho pana (syā. kaṃ.)] araññe viharantaṃ
segments.an5.77:2.5: ahi vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, vicchiko [vicchikā (syā.)] vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, satapadī vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya,
segments.an5.77:2.6: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
segments.an5.77:2.7: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an5.77:2.8: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.77:3.4: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā bhuttaṃ me byāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ,
segments.an5.77:3.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
segments.an5.77:3.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an5.77:3.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.77:4.4: vāḷehi samāgaccheyyaṃ, sīhena vā byagghena vā dīpinā vā acchena vā taracchena vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
segments.an5.77:4.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
segments.an5.77:4.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an5.77:4.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.77:5.4: māṇavehi samāgaccheyyaṃ katakammehi vā akatakammehi vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
segments.an5.77:5.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
segments.an5.77:5.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an5.77:5.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.77:6.3: Santi kho panāraññe vāḷā amanussā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
segments.an5.77:6.4: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
segments.an5.77:6.5: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an5.77:6.6: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.77:7.1: “Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.

lines: So mamassa antarāyoti so mama jīvitantarāyo ca brahmacariyantarāyo ca, puthujjanakālakiriyaṃ karontassa saggantarāyo ca maggantarāyo ca bhaveyya.
Katakammehi vā akatakammehi vāti ettha corikaṃ katvā nikkhantā katakammā nāma, corikaṃ kātuṃ gacchantā akatakammā nāma.
Tattha katakammā kammassa nipphannattā sattānaṃ galalohitaṃ gahetvā devatānaṃ baliṃ karonti, akatakammā “evaṃ no kammaṃ nipphajjissatī”ti paṭhamataraṃ karonti.
Idaṃ sandhāya te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyunti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ pana caṅkamanavasena karaṇe “kāyika”ntipi vattabbataṃ labhatīti āha –
Te kira katakammā yaṃ nesaṃ devataṃ āyācitvā kammaṃ nipphannaṃ, tassa upakāratthāya manusse māretvā galalohitāni gaṇhanti.
Te “aññesu manussesu māriyamānesu kolāhalaṃ uppajjissati, pabbajitaṃ pariyesanto nāma natthī”ti maññamānā bhikkhū gahetvā mārenti.
Akatakammehīti aṭavito gāmaṃ āgamanakāle kammanipphattatthaṃ puretaraṃ balikammaṃ kātukāmehi.
